name: rengine-agent
description: A local model behind a C ABI: open a model declared by path and digest, run one turn with an optional grammar, stream tokens, cancel within one token, and report identity and counters. The engine underneath is llama_r.cpp, this project's fork of llama.cpp, which the pack does NOT vendor - a consumer pins both and points the pack at it. C because the door is C: the FFI direction in this family is Rust-imports-C, so a Rust service, a C desktop and a game reach one implementation. Charter D67/D68/D72; specs 139 and 150.
note: The revision below is the commit a consumer pins, and it is rEngine's own: a project that already carries third_party/rengine receives this pack with a pin it already holds, so nothing here fetches anything (spec 111, KI-008). The engine is a SECOND pin the consumer holds separately - github.com/alex-nax/llama_r.cpp, branch red - because a pack that vendored a 400 MB engine would be a pack nobody could review. Weights are neither shipped nor fetched: a model is declared per machine by path and digest, and an undeclared or unverified file is refused (charter D68).
